name: r7-02-late-findings
title: The two findings filed against e1783d0d minutes before the merge, checked on the real stack
subtitle: A: yiliang114's channel_disconnected finding (confirmed; follow-up #13768 verified). B: qqqys's char-vs-byte text guard (not reproduced: refused before staging).

panels.h: A on the merged head: mail lost until the adapter restarts
panels.t:
## internal POST …/channels/rigmail/disconnect while the adapter runs
## (a stale process's late disconnect, or an operator call)
12:38:23 /inbound  -- 409 channel_disconnected
-- "admission of …:2 was refused (409); the message is skipped."
-- every tick: /deliveries:claim 409 channel_disconnected
-- the adapter never registers again; a second mail at 12:38:47
--   is skipped the same way; the channel stays disconnected

panels.h: A with #13768's diff applied (the follow-up PR)
panels.t:
## same disconnect, #13768 adapter
12:51:11.619 /inbound   !! 409 channel_disconnected → kept pending
12:51:11.631 :claim     !! 409 → "outbox claim was refused as not
!!   registered; the next poll re-registers first."
12:51:14.660 PUT        ++ 200 connected (re-registered)
12:51:15.023 /inbound   ++ 200 admitted; reply 9.4 s after the mail
++ email suite 57/57 with #13768's two new tests
== nit: the inbound log still says "did not answer"

panels.h: B: oversized CJK text with an attachment
panels.t:
## internal /inbound, bypassing the adapter's byte clamp
## text 21,906 chars / 65,706 bytes (< 32,000 chars, > 64 KiB)
## plus a 2,000-byte attachment
-- Harness: 400 invalid_channel_operation (deterministic)
++ managed-channel-attachment resources before 0 / after 0
++ the byte verdict lands before any attachment is staged
== email never reaches it: the adapter clamps by bytes

note: PR #13572 was merged at e1783d0d (11:39:59 UTC) while this round was running; A is fixed by the open follow-up #13768, verified here.
